**What are you trying to understand?**

e.g. why a particular module is structured a certain way, why a business
rule works the way it does, or something you ran into while reading the
code.

**What have you already checked?**

This project tries hard to keep its docs current — please check whether
this is already answered before opening the issue:

- [`docs/guide/`](../../docs/guide/) — business-domain guide, system
  design doc, and full API reference.
- [`docs/business-domain/glossary.md`](../../docs/business-domain/glossary.md) —
  domain terminology.
- [`DEV_README.md`](../../DEV_README.md) — the development log, including
  the reasoning behind specific past decisions.

If none of those cover it, that's useful signal on its own — the question
is probably worth adding to the docs.
